whatIsIt.eli5: Makes shape pictures using notes from all map sizes.
whatIsIt.simple: Adds the P4 and P5 maps (resized) into P3, then makes the mask prototypes. Has a training-only branch for per-pixel classes.
whatIsIt.engineer: feat_refine[i] Conv1×1(ch[i+1]→ch0), interpolate ×2^(i+1), sum → feat_fuse Conv3×3 → Proto; semseg (train only).

whyExists.eli5: Big-picture notes help tell where one thing ends.
whyExists.simple: Deeper maps carry more meaning; mixing them in helps mask quality.

eli5: Bring all map sizes to one size.
engineer: Returns (protos, semantic) in training, protos at inference.
